title: Video and motion with code
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for video and motion made with code: tested code shipped in the pack and pinned by digest, scene recipes, a procedural asset catalog, motion formulas, aspect, caption and audio rules, every-frame and post-encode checks, a demo sequence, media and tool cards, with verbs to seek frames, fit motion, draft, compile and check scenes, and plan, render and check a video.
boundaries: Keep every output in the requester's scope. Releasing a video is the owner's separate decision.
Rendering and checking use no model per frame or per check.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.
Workers run the pack's code only from an installation that matches its digest, under their own permissions.

nouns.title: Motion formulas: six narrative beats and five easing curves

value.summary: Timing and motion as formulas, not footage: six beats with canonical proportions, five easing curves, and two built-in profiles.

beats.job: The subject pops into frame at once.
Establish the cast and the problem.
Introduce the baseline or the contrast.
The payoff or the final comparison.
A clean hold so viewers can read the last frame.

easings.ease_in_out_cubic: a cubic S-curve that accelerates to u = 0.5 and decelerates to 1
easings.spring_pop: f(u) = 1 - (1 - u) * exp(-5u) * cos(2.5 * pi * u), overshooting about 1.05

rules: Retargeting maps each beat boundary to an exact frame: round(ratio * total_frames) / fps.
A learned profile stores ratios, easing fits, cut cadence, normalized waypoints and its digest; never media.

nouns.category_reason: Reusable parametric motion: beat proportions and easing curves for any cast and duration.

value.summary: Three output aspects, each with its size, platform keep-out boxes, safe canvas and minimum caption size.
rules: A recipe's stage_aspect names the safe canvas its coordinates use; other aspects map positions between safe canvases and scale sizes to fit.
Per-aspect overrides (dx, dy, scale_mul, opacity_mul, rotation_offset_deg) adapt the layout, for example restacking a 16:9 diagram for 9:16.
On 4:5 the lower-right area is usable; on 9:16 it is under the platform's buttons.

nouns.category_reason: A reusable layout method: sizes, safe areas and keep-outs that every render and check reads.

nouns.title: Caption rules: size, wrapping, timing and placement

value.summary: How the tools wrap, time and place captions, and what pre-render QA enforces.
rules: Lines are wrapped for balance (minimum raggedness), at most 3 lines per cue, none longer than the cue's max_chars_per_line plus 4.
Captions are at least min_font_px tall for the aspect and stay inside its safe canvas, clear of keep-out boxes and subjects.
Each cue shows for at least min_display_s and reads at most max_chars_per_second; no 1 to 2 frame blink gaps.
Captions are burned in from PNG overlays and also written as SRT and WebVTT sidecars with the same timings.

nouns.category_reason: A reusable caption method with its limits, read by drafting, rendering and checking verbs.

nouns.title: Audio plan: narration, a ducked music bed and loudness

value.summary: How a sequence's audio is planned and mixed.
rules: Narration elements play where the sequence places them; one optional music bed is ducked under narration by sidechain compression.
The mix is normalized to the sequence's loudness target with two linear loudnorm passes, at or below its true-peak limit.
Audio is AAC at sample_rate_hz in stereo. Per-stem peaks stay at or below -1 dBFS in scene QA.
Sound effects and ambience are mixed into the music bed before rendering; the tools mix only narration and one bed.

nouns.category_reason: A reusable audio method: placement, ducking, loudness target and limits for rendered sequences.

nouns.title: Every-frame scene checks

value.summary: Eight deterministic checks on every frame of a scene recipe, for each aspect, before a deliverable can pass.

checks.threshold: Every caption and callout box is inside the frame and clear of the aspect's keep-out boxes.
Type at least the aspect's minimum size; at most 3 lines; balanced lines with no one-word orphans.
No caption covers a visible focal subject's keep-out box.
No cue shorter than max(4, 0.14 x fps) frames, no 1 to 2 frame blink gaps, no box jitter above 1.5 px.
No unintended dark run of 3 or more frames and no frozen state over 1.5 s outside the hold beat.
At most 3 flashes (6 luminance jumps of 0.20 or more) in any 1 s window.
Stems and the ducked mix at or below -1 dBFS; no overlapping captions on one anchor.
Every actor and audio asset has an allowed license, a creator and a 64-hex digest.

rules: The report commits every check, finding and the credit line into qa_receipt_sha256.
These checks read scene state and declared audio levels, not decoded pixels or waveforms, and attest no rights.
The flash check is a parametric screening rule, not a photosensitivity certification.

nouns.category_reason: A fixed set of deterministic checks with thresholds that every scene deliverable is scored against.

nouns.title: Post-encode video checks

value.summary: Eight checks on the decoded pixels and audio of a rendered MP4, judged against its sequence plan. Every check must pass.

checks.threshold: H.264 yuv420p at the aspect's size and the plan's frame rate; AAC 48 kHz stereo.
Decoded frames equal the plan; container duration within one frame plus aac_slack_s.
On spot_frames frames of one scene clip: the manifest hash equals a fresh evaluation, the reference PNG is unchanged, and SSIM is at least ssim_min and higher than against a visibly different frame.
No black run of black_min_s or longer.
Every freeze of freeze_min_s or longer lies inside a planned hold, allowing 0.75 s of easing tail.
Within loudness_tolerance_lu of the sequence's target; true peak at or below its limit.
Captions cover at least caption_coverage_min of measured speech, no cue without speech, sidecars equal the track.
The file's title and disclosure comment are exactly what the render manifest records.

rules: Before FFmpeg runs, every manifest path is confined to the render directory and every recorded digest is verified; the manifest's commands are never executed.
Caption coverage is measured against narration loudness, not words.
Spot checks cover frames showing exactly one scene clip; transitions and overlays are covered by the stream, black, freeze and loudness checks.
